title: 2025/26 league phase: the top ten
brief: Name the clubs that finished first to tenth in the 36-team league phase of the 2025/26 Champions League. The top eight went straight to the round of 16.
period: Champions League 2025/26 league phase (September 2025 to January 2026)

notes.PSG: PSG were 11th on 14 points and went on to win the final.

checks: Table from Wikipedia checked by rebuilding it from all 144 league phase results in UEFA's match data: same points, goals and order. Barcelona, Chelsea, Sporting and Man City all had 16 points and are split by goal difference (+8, +7, +6, +6) then goals scored (Sporting 17, Man City 15); Real Madrid and Inter on 15 by goal difference (+9, +8).
